description: Source file implementing the ConfigFile class for persisting configuration data related to crash reporting, including directory management, data appending, and file writing.

classes.name: ConfigFile
classes.description: Class responsible for persisting crash report configuration data to disk, including directory creation, data appending, and file management.

methods.name: EnsureDirectoryPathExists
methods.description: Ensures that a directory path exists, creating it with specific permissions if necessary.

methods.name: ConfigFile::WriteData
methods.description: Writes raw data to the configuration file.

methods.name: ConfigFile::AppendConfigData
methods.description: Appends key-value data to the configuration file in a specific format.

methods.name: ConfigFile::AppendConfigString
methods.description: Convenience method to append string data associated with a key.

methods.name: ConfigFile::AppendCrashTimeParameters
methods.description: Appends crash time and process uptime parameters to the configuration.

methods.name: ConfigFile::WriteFile
methods.description: Creates and writes the entire configuration file with provided parameters, dump directory, and minidump ID.
